instruction: Playful studio full shot photograph against a plain white background. On the left, the dark-skinned woman with curly black hair (R1) in a white t-shirt and blue jeans sits barefoot on a red armchair, laughing happily. On the right, the young girl with long straight dark hair (R2), wearing an oversized plaid coat, blue jeans, and oversized black high heels, leans forward to hug the woman. Bright, even studio lighting fills the space, emphasizing the warm interaction and the bold red of the armchair.

R1 is seated and receives the embrace from R2
R1 remains seated on the red armchair while R2 approaches her
R1 is supported by the red armchair during the interaction
